title: Weight-space programming for tractor guidance controller: large language models natively write neural network weights that steer a real tractor
abstract: arXiv:2611.21958v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weight-space programming is a process where a large language model reads and writes the weights of a neural network directly, guided by a natural language specification, without an optimiser or gradient descent. This study applies it to automatic tractor guidance, where a 253-parameter neural network steers along paths of lines and arcs and must be adapted when the machine changes, such as a slower steering actuator. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 (also 5.2) edited the network for our research tractor using a small budget of simulated evaluations to repair a network trained for another tractor and write a controller into a network with zero weights. We compared them with an evolution strategy, gradient descent and pure pursuit in simulation and on the real tractor. translated_title: 面向拖拉机导航控制器的权重空间编程：大语言模型原生编写可驾驶真实拖拉机的神经网络权重
translated_abstract: 权重空间编程是一种由大语言模型在自然语言规范的指导下直接读取和写入神经网络权重的过程，无需优化器或梯度下降。本研究将其应用于拖拉机自动导航任务：一个仅含253个参数的神经网络沿直线和圆弧路径行驶，并在机器条件发生变化时（例如转向执行器变慢）需要进行调整。GPT-6 Astra和Claude Fable 5.1（以及5.2）以少量模拟评估为预算，为我们的研究用拖拉机编辑网络，修复了原本为另一台拖拉机训练的网络，并将控制器直接写入一个零权重初始化的网络中。我们在模拟和真实拖拉机上将其与进化策略、梯度下降和纯追踪算法进行了对比。两个模型都能正确读取网络并运用控制理论准确分析闭环系统，而Fable在不借助模拟的情况下进行修复仅偶尔成功。
tldr: 大语言模型通过权重空间编程直接读取、修复并从零编写拖拉机导航控制器的神经网络权重，无需优化器或梯度下降，在模拟和真实拖拉机上均实现了成功的路径跟踪。
en_tdlr: Large language models natively read, repair, and write neural network weights for a tractor guidance controller through weight-space programming—without optimizers or gradient descent—successfully steering along paths in both simulation and on a real tractor.
